signal_basis: predicted_params.json: pipeline = blur_gaussian:3 (UNCERTAIN) + saturate_strengthen_HSV:2 (UNCERTAIN), tier 2, PSNR mode sigma=0.62, 5-pair PSNR 24.28-28.47 dB (<30) → 不满足任何组件 Tier S/A 门控

full_analysis.json step4_global: variance_ratio=0.9832, contrast_from_variance=false, contrast_detected_raw=false → 无 Tier A contrast 信号, 不启用 ColorPre/FiLM-GCM (finetune_strategy §七: ColorPre/FiLM-GCM 需 variance_ratio≠1.0)

full_analysis_p1.json step4_global: variance_ratio=1.3716 但 false_positive_checks 标注 contrast_from_saturation=true 且 brightness_clip_explains_variance=true → variance 抬升由饱和/clipping 假阳性解释, 非真实 contrast, 维持不启用 contrast 组件

full_analysis.json step3_blur: gm_ratio=0.7124, spectral_slope_ratio=1.047, BLUR_UNLIKELY; full_analysis_p1 residual_anisotropy=1.1672 (<1.7) 且无 motion 证据 → OCAB 门控不满足 (§七: anisotropy>1.7 + motion 才启用)

full_analysis.json step1/step2: block_boundary=1.0017, unique_G=242 (无压缩); noise_prior sigma=0.62 < 2, peeled sigma=1.24 < 2, spatial_corr=0.9695 (确定性结构), extreme_pct=64% 属已知 clipping/blur 假阳性 → 无噪声/压缩步骤贡献结构性局部信号, 无 CSN/FiLM 结构化触发

reflection.json final_decision: 25 次候选测试, best=blur_gaussian:3+saturate_strengthen_HSV:2; R19/R20 显示追加 brightness_darken 会掉 PSNR (21.82/22.18 vs 25.99) → 管线含全局 saturation, 按 §六 Step 1 含全局退化推荐 Direct 保守策略
SimpleGate 默认常开: exp39 8/9 退化安全 (-32K 参数), 仅 S5 motion×3 -0.86, 本挑战无 motion
rationale: 双步 UNCERTAIN (blur_gaussian:3 + saturate_strengthen_HSV:2), 无 Tier S/A 信号 (variance_ratio≈1.0 且 pair1 方差比被 saturation/clipping FP 解释, anisotropy 1.17<1.7 且非 motion, 无压缩/无噪声), 按 finetune_strategy.md §七 门控规则所有专用组件均不启用; 管线含全局 saturation → Direct 最安全; 架构取纯 Swin + SimpleGate 默认配置, lr=5e-4, EPOCH=2 与基线对齐。
